description: This is a Java class file defining the LoanScheduleService, which manages regeneration and recalculation of loan repayment schedules, interacts with various other services and data models related to loans and charges.

classes.name: LoanScheduleService
classes.description: A service class that handles regeneration and recalculation of loan repayment schedules, managing interactions with charges, transactions, and schedule models.

methods.name: regenerateRepaymentSchedule
methods.description: Regenerates the repayment schedule for a given loan based on the latest loan details and schedule generator parameters.

methods.name: recalculateSchedule
methods.description: Recalculates the loan schedule, either with interest recalculation enabled or normally, and reprocesses transactions.

methods.name: recalculateScheduleFromLastTransaction
methods.description: Recalculates schedule from the last transaction, with an option to skip transaction ID collection, and handles interest recalculations if applicable.

methods.name: regenerateRepaymentScheduleWithInterestRecalculation
methods.description: Regenerates the repayment schedule considering interest recalculation, updates charges, and transaction processing.

methods.name: handleRegenerateRepaymentScheduleWithInterestRecalculation
methods.description: Wrapper method to regenerate repayment schedule with interest recalculation and reprocess transactions.
